item.tib: yang dag rin chen sgron ma yis bdag gzhan gnyis med bro
item.coloph: de ltar bzlas chog rin chen sgron ma yis/ gzhung skabs cha lag phan yon dang bcas pa 'di ni/ rgyal ba bstan pa'i gtso bos/ gto bu 'bum sangs la brgyud/ gto bu 'bum sangs kyis/ lha bon yongs su dag pa la brgyud/ lha bon yongs su dag pas/ dbra btsun nam mkha' rin chen la brgyud/ dbra btsun nam mkha' rin chen gyis/ rtogs ldan shes rab blo gros la brgyud/ rtogs ldan shes rab blo gros kyis/ bdag 'gru btsun shes rab 'od zer la brgyud pa'o/ phyi rabs rjes 'breng rnams kyis kyang de ltar spyad par bya'o/ 'gro don nyi ma'i zer bzhin rgyas par gyur cig/
